d: Will Sheikh Hasina really return to Bangladesh on December 16? In this WION exclusive, Sheikh Wali Asif Inan, General Secretary of the banned Bangladesh Chhatra League, who has himself been sentenced to death by the International Crimes Tribunal, says the ousted prime minister's homecoming is "no political stunt." Speaking from an undisclosed location, he claims the government is afraid of her because it lacks public support, calls PM Tariq Rahman's "terrorist" charge a lie, and says the ban on the Awami League is illegal.
